minecraft:emitter_initialization.creation_expression: variable.radius = 0.75; variable.rise_speed = 0.25; variable.travel_speed = 1.5; variable.phase = variable.emitter_random_1 * 360; variable.strand_index = -1;

offset: variable.strand_index = math.mod(variable.strand_index + 1, 2); variable.spawn_phase = variable.phase + variable.strand_index * 180; variable.spawn_direction = 1 - 2 * variable.strand_index; return variable.radius * math.cos(variable.spawn_phase);
direction: -40 * variable.radius * math.sin(4.5 * variable.travel_speed * variable.spawn_direction) * math.sin(variable.spawn_phase + 4.5 * variable.travel_speed * variable.spawn_direction)
40 * variable.radius * math.sin(4.5 * variable.travel_speed * variable.spawn_direction) * math.cos(variable.spawn_phase + 4.5 * variable.travel_speed * variable.spawn_direction)

components.minecraft:particle_initial_speed: variable.particle_phase = variable.spawn_phase; variable.particle_direction = variable.spawn_direction; return math.sqrt(1600 * variable.radius * variable.radius * math.sin(4.5 * variable.travel_speed) * math.sin(4.5 * variable.travel_speed) + variable.rise_speed * variable.rise_speed * variable.travel_speed * variable.travel_speed);

linear_acceleration: -1600 * variable.radius * math.sin(4.5 * variable.travel_speed) * math.sin(4.5 * variable.travel_speed) * math.cos(variable.particle_phase + variable.particle_age * 180 * variable.travel_speed * variable.particle_direction)

-1600 * variable.radius * math.sin(4.5 * variable.travel_speed) * math.sin(4.5 * variable.travel_speed) * math.sin(variable.particle_phase + variable.particle_age * 180 * variable.travel_speed * variable.particle_direction)

size: (0.09 + variable.particle_random_3 * 0.05) * math.min(1, variable.particle_age * 10) * math.min(1, math.max(0, (variable.particle_lifetime - variable.particle_age) * 2))
